newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN SHARES EXTEND GAINS, MORE SEEN.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN SHARES EXTEND GAINS, MORE SEEN.

text.p: Lithuanian shares extended their recent gains on Wednesday as low prices and solid results lured institutional and foreign investors to the market, dealers said.
The official list, which tracks the five top stocks, rose by 11.32 points to 1,132.74 points while the broader group A index advanced by 37.43 points to 1,941.48.
The central market turned over 828,000 litas while 1.4 million litas was registered in block trades.
"The number of institutional investors has increased," Grazhina Bachiuliene of Vilfima's asset managment firm told Reuters.
"Lately the activity of individual Lithuanian investors has also increased," Bachiuliene added.
"Official list shares should continue to grow, especially the stocks of Birzhu Dairy, Vilniaus Bank and Rokishkis Cheese," said Tomas Andrejauskas of Suprema brokerage.
Rokishkis Cheese rose to 49.00 litas from 48.35 litas in central market trade of 176,000 litas.
In block trades it turned over 422,000 litas in prices ranging from 49 to 49.30 litas.
Hermis Bank rose to 270 litas from 267 but dealers were divided over its future prospects.
Some dealers said that the price was being pushed up by the bank buying its own shares but others said its recent gains were supported by sound fundamentals and that it had room to climb further.
